ideas.title: The Scope of Minnesota's Fraud Problem
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of the fraud problem in Minnesota, including connections to other states and potential misuse of funds.
questions: What is the total amount of alleged fraud?
What are the key players involved?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of fraud and misuse of funds in Minnesota and potentially other states.

ideas.title: The Impact of Fraud on Minnesota's Medicaid Program
ideas.description: Examine the impact of fraud on Minnesota's Medicaid program, including delayed payments and potential program termination.
questions: What is the effect on patients and providers?
What steps are being taken to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the consequences of fraud in the Medicaid program and potential solutions.
